garrytan.en: Founders need earnestness and courage; agentic coding turns markdown skills into employees, replacing mid-level management, though society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他重申创始人需要真诚与勇气；智能体式编程让 markdown 技能变成员工、取代中层管理，但社会变迁仍需约 20 年。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, while treating AI as its primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年他强调，Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和一次流片成功（first-time-pass）的工程纪律重建客户信任，并把 AI 视为首要增长引擎。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will exceed the internet tenfold; after generative AI, agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复判断 AI 的影响将十倍于互联网，生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪是智能体式 AI 与物理 AI。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责和客户导向上，并提出大公司里坏消息必须比好消息更快传到 CEO 耳中。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, aided by advanced packaging and new materials.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，并靠先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料突破物理极限。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all technology; vertical integration and contrarian early investment in bottlenecks like interconnect, power, and thermal create lasting value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步升华：半导体是一切技术的底座，垂直整合与逆势押注互连、供电、散热等瓶颈环节才能创造长期价值。

jasonyuan.en: Design taste means editing away and saying no; shipping distills 99 nos, and post-training away AI weirdness lost a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计品味在于做减法和说不；每个上线功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏，而后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，也让我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social, so the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延伸物种与镜像，而非冰冷工具；计算本质上是社会性的，因此个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions, sharpened by theater training's multi-sensory approach.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，而非来自单一视角；直觉是创作决策的内脏罗盘，戏剧训练的多感官方法将其磨砺。

jasonyuan.en: Creative work should be honest and personal, telling stories only you can tell; the best design comes from what you believe is true, not what the world wants.
jasonyuan.zh: 创作应诚实而个人化，讲只有你能讲的故事；最好的设计源于你相信为真之物，而非世界想要之物。

jasonyuan.en: Design should embrace the full human experience, including envy and lust; high design often feels sexless and sanded down, losing desire and objectionable elements.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计应拥抱完整的人类体验，包括嫉妒与欲望；高级设计常显得无性而被打磨光滑，失去了欲望与令人不适的元素。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it with short iterative prompts rather than long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短的迭代对话引导它，而不是堆砌冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the open internet.
steinberger.zh: 对智能体系统而言安全是首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱隔离，绝不能直接暴露在公网上。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier and harder to navigate.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。模型智能并不会退化，只是你的项目越来越乱、越来越难导航。

steinberger.en: Rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM. Fun and play drive mastery.
steinberger.zh: 他反对“氛围编程”这一贬称：严肃开发应叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后；乐趣与玩耍才是精通的驱动力。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw are the alternative to lab agents—democratizing programming—but may be financially unsustainable and need opinionated focus.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体是实验室智能体的替代方案，让编程民主化，但可能财务上不可持续，也需要有主见地保持专注。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI 模型统治世界，主张专业化智能将占主导；随着开放模型与 token 成本下降，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，这已从可选项变成必需品。

linqiao.en: Post-training, not the app, is the durable moat: baking unique judgment and data into models lets startups cut costs 5-10x and scale profitably against frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把护城河从应用层移到后训练：把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，可降本 5-10 倍，让初创公司能盈利地扩张并与前沿模型竞争；应用易被克隆，模型才是更强壁垒。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; incumbents too can scale into bankruptcy, so growth must be optimized before margins.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他修正了产品市场契合的旧信念：它不再保证持久生意，在位者也可能因 Scaling（规模扩张）成本而破产，因此必须先优化增长再谈利润。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning from facts to taste to expertise; data quality and systematic evals beat volume and vibe checks.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的路径类比人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习；数据质量胜过数量，应把凭感觉的评估转为系统化评估。

linqiao.en: Sovereign models and owned intelligence infrastructure are necessary; chip building is premature for most, and the inference layer is not a commodity but a source of lasting value.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张主权模型与自有智能基础设施是必要的；对多数公司而言自建芯片为时过早，而推理层并非商品化，专业化部署与定制才是持久价值所在。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are the key to physical AI generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作当年 Transformer 时刻的重演：硬件已就绪、软件在追赶，开源与数据多样性是物理 AI 泛化的关键。

thomaswolf.en: World models and video generation can synthesize training data, easing robotics' data bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他持续强调世界模型与视频生成能合成训练数据，缓解机器人数据瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxing, is the decisive security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，真正的决定性安全层是对齐，而非沙箱与护栏。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; a deliberate slowdown needs open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警告：缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，而有意放缓需要开放科学与国际合作。

thomaswolf.en: Open source wins long term on cost and control, and openness need not mean accelerationism.
thomaswolf.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源凭成本与控制力终将胜出，且支持开放并不等于支持加速主义。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, tinker, and keep individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张浏览器设计必须靠原型验证：设计师应追随好奇心、动手试错，保留个人印记，而不是让团队始终作为一个整体行动。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data persists, but by 2026 he leans further toward ideas and taste over execution as engineering gets easier.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，直觉与数据的平衡这条主线延续，但随着工程变容易，他更偏向想法与品味，而非执行。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; rich context and prescriptive prompts matter, while models handle mockups and busy work.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Claude Design 始于一人副业项目；关键在于提供丰富上下文和明确指令，让模型承担 mockup 与琐碎工作。

nateparrott.en: He now accepts shipping rough, throwaway artifacts and being uncomfortably early, since models lack taste and humans still monopolize design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他接受交付粗糙、一次性的产物并宁早勿晚，因为模型仍缺乏品味，好设计想法仍由人类垄断。

nateparrott.en: Design tools gain value as engineering commoditizes; rapid prototyping revives features previously impossible, and custom editors solve specific design problems.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，随着工程能力商品化，设计工具更有价值；快速原型让过去无法实现的功能重见天日，自定义编辑器则解决具体设计问题。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define AI software; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, startups win in applied agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 软件将围绕智能体与按结果定价展开；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在应用层智能体。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not value, business outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调编程智能体让开发者从写代码者变为操作者；token 消耗不是价值，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI from specialized vendors will democratize expertise; incumbents fail on business models, not technology.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：专业厂商的应用 AI 将普及专业能力；在位者的障碍是商业模式而非技术。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, not wait in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把安全观落为负责任迭代部署：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，而非象牙塔式等待。

brettaylor.en: AI should be a utility like search, expanding markets; agents beat humans at coding yet elevate the role.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 应像搜索一样成为公用事业并扩大市场；智能体编程已强于人，但提升而非取代人的角色。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload; its research-to-production timeline is hours, and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载；从研究到生产的周期只有数小时，推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering requires a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and specialized systems for agentic applications are crucial.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程需要在延迟、吞吐量和成本之间权衡；为智能体式应用构建专用系统至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, but calibrating it to workloads can yield cost and speed benefits; more layers can even improve quality.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化，但针对工作负载进行校准可以带来成本和速度优势；量化更多层甚至能提升质量。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; future GPUs like Rubin shift focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练和蒸馏，推理工程正与训练融合；未来如 Rubin 等 GPU 将重心转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Disaggregated prefill and decode with KV cache management is key; continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction than weight updates.
philipkiely.zh: 分离式预填充和解码与 KV 缓存管理是关键；持续学习可能更适合通过 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新来解决。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习与合成数据实现的后训练 Scaling（规模扩张），可以突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此要用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; prototyping replaces specs.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective human judgment; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化了“艺术而非科学”的判断：后训练仍依赖人的主观判断，需要多样且持续的基准来评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; more companies should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她警告前沿模型的智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，基准必须持续演进；并主张更多公司训练自己的模型，以保留独特知识与多元声音。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and iterate from references, not chase trends; the best are editors, not originators.
mengto.zh: 设计师应构建自己的 AI 工具并从参考中迭代，而非追逐趋势；最优秀的人是编辑者，而非原创者。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; to leverage superintelligent models you need giant prompts with context and design systems.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；要利用超级智能模型，你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示。

mengto.en: Writing 0% of the code is possible now, but precise communication with AI is essential; curiosity and workflow refinement are constant.
mengto.zh: 现在可以 0% 写代码，但与 AI 精确沟通至关重要；好奇心和持续优化工作流是常态。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams; action beats certainty.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，使一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事；行动胜过确定性。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients, launch at 80% complete, and fund with clients not VC.
mengto.zh: 专注于为高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，在 80% 完成时发布，用客户资金而非风投来资助。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring is real: cheaper services let fewer US workers serve more people, and AGI means agents run profitably without humans.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 正推动就业回流美国：服务变便宜，更少美国工人服务更多人；并把 AGI 定义为智能体能无人工干预地持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Adoption hinges on the CEO using AI daily; a head of AI operations and Claude Code for non-coders matter more than engineering hype.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年他强调企业采用 AI 的头号预测指标是 CEO 是否每天亲自用 AI，并看重 AI 运营负责人与非程序员用 Claude Code 自动化任务。

danshipper.en: The job apocalypse is a lie: everyone gets an agent, but agents need a caring human overseer; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他断言“AI 就业末日”是谎言：人人有智能体，但智能体需要关心它的人类监督；Codex 等图形界面取代命令行成为工作界面。

danshipper.en: SaaS survives and grows as agents add users; benchmarks overstate autonomy, and real tasks still need human framing.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他转向看好 SaaS：智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户；并指出基准高估自主性，真实任务仍需人类框定与监督。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your taste and mindset; it commoditizes frozen skills yet creates more human craft work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你的品味与心态；它把固化技能商品化，却创造更多人类技艺工作，且即便超级智能仍只是工具。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are highly valued.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则：发现用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；能写代码、做设计、与用户交流的通用型工程师极受重视。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's model; scaffolding is temporary tech debt, so don't bet against the model.
boris.zh: 为六个月后的模型构建，而不是今天的模型；脚手架是临时技术债，不要与模型对赌。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of my code is written by Claude Code, and the software engineer title will fade into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决：我的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，软件工程师头衔将淡出，演变为“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety is core, not sci-fi: releasing early in the wild and using coding as a clean domain for alignment research improves model safety.
boris.zh: 安全是核心而非科幻：尽早真实发布，并以编程作为对齐研究的清晰领域，能提升模型安全性。

boris.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; give models tools and let them self-verify, with less instruction and more empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 智能体之后的下一抽象层是循环；给模型工具让其自我验证，减少指令、更多实证迭代。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳，让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption through small-team, bootstrapped experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 依靠小团队、自举式实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, translating feedback into specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，把用户反馈转化为具体细节。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future to capture alpha; transformative long-running AI is closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是提前活在未来、捕捉 alpha；变革性的长时运行 AI 比预期更近。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; Devin acts as a junior engineer under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策，Devin 像初级工程师一样在人类监督下异步处理明确任务。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not reduce, software engineers via Jevons paradox; base intelligence suffices, product interface is the bottleneck.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 会让程序员更多而非更少；基础智能已够用，真正的瓶颈是人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; enterprise agent adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他反对 AGI 突变论，认为进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体靠信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他从角色转变转向规模化落地：编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍，生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The token-max era ended in 2026; independence enables model neutrality, and the abundance era is approaching but the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：token 最大化时代已结束，独立性带来模型中立；丰裕时代临近，但奇点并不迫近，真正解锁靠容量而非效率。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此应让其保持掌控。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't hard since they can't capture all customers; founders should focus, not fear frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难，因为它们无法俘获所有客户；创始人应专注，而非畏惧前沿模型。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it, leaving room for improvement.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；AI 编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解，仍有改进空间。

logankilpatrick.en: Solving software creation by 2026 creates a thousand times more opportunity, not less; the delta between engineering, product and research blurs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年软件创造被基本解决，会带来千倍机会而非减少；工程、产品与研究的界限正变模糊。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will shrink clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make biology an engineering discipline enabling cell programming.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，AI 将使生物学成为可编程细胞的工程学科。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal and near-100% curable cancer follow from AI-designed personalized medicine.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度；衰老逆转与近 100% 可治愈的癌症将随 AI 设计的个性化医疗而来。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应近乎 100% 信任超级智能；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limitations.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限性的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，这些领域劳动力短缺使自主化迫在眉睫。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning; world models are shifting to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他表示自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，它比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Automotive is only 30% of business and will shrink; real growth is in mining, agriculture, and defense, with Tesla's end-to-end approach winning on cost.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他断言汽车业务仅占 30%且将萎缩；真正增长在采矿、农业和国防，特斯拉的端到端模式将因成本胜出。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily; product taste is the most valuable skill as code becomes cheaper.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，每周甚至每天发布功能；随着代码成本降低，产品品味成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag are used internally to build themselves.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体让工程师将实现工作委托出去，专注于产品品味和商业判断；Claude Code 和 Claude Tag 在内部用于构建自身。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; giving examples can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，前沿模型的系统提示词通过移除示例和硬性约束缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断；提供示例可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer for prompt injection and data exfiltration risks; humans should be removed from code review for outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，在提示注入和数据外泄风险上，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全；对于外层变更，应将人类从代码审查循环中移除。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine; tool design is more biology than physics.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，重写代码现在可行；代码库就是规格说明，有了好的测试套件重写没问题；工具设计更像生物学而非物理学。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: scope clear roles, grant progressive trust, and start with one before specializing.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当员工：明确角色、逐步授权，先从一个开始再专业化。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skill for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 要让智能体成功，管理能力（界定角色、上手引导）比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes and even project-manage humans, reversing the usual human-AI dynamic.
clairevo.zh: 智能体能对结果负责，甚至反向管理人类任务，颠覆通常的人机关系。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and supply first-principles creativity LLMs lack.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任仍在：必须为 AI 产出负责，并提供大模型缺乏的第一性原理创造力。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate agents as a team; earned insight and founder-market fit, not tech, are the moat.
clairevo.zh: 单人创始人把智能体当作团队来编排；真正的护城河是洞察与创始人-市场契合，而非技术。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by optimizing user satisfaction.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习为迎合用户满意度反而会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已进入收益递减——数据墙与算力上限当下已现；要进一步进步需要推理与搜索等新方法。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and rigid workflows fall short.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关性错误，僵化工作流也不够。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception, not just errors, when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）不仅带来错误，还会激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—no 'smells' for mistakes—so truth should be a design principle, possibly reviving linguistic structure.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——错误没有“气味”——因此真相应成为设计原则，语言结构或可回归为可靠性的表示。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量和互联网或移动互联网一样大，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing without network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；价值会向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是有限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Adoption is still shallow: most people use AI occasionally, not daily, so better models alone won't drive mass adoption.
benedictevans.zh: 采用仍然很浅：多数人只是偶尔使用 AI 而非每天使用，因此仅靠更好的模型无法推动大规模采用。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; predicting which jobs AI replaces is futile, and the hard part is context and judgment.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会以不可预测的方式创造新工作；预测 AI 取代哪些工作是徒劳的，难点在于上下文与判断。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而不只是靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此单纯靠算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale—so neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，词元越多准确率越低——因此权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge via parameter-efficient fine-tuning, beating RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应借参数高效微调用于企业知识，在整体性查询上胜过检索增强。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models: continual learning runs on-device, with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型：持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and leaders should be asked directly for help.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通产生；应当直接向领导者求助。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient without world models and common sense.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；仅有缩放定律不够，还需要世界模型与常识。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic, commoditizing complements and accelerating collective progress asymmetrically.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略举措，能商品化互补层，并不对称地加速集体进步。

bosworth.en: The app-centric world is outdated; AI inverts the model as users express intent and agents orchestrate services, abstracting brands.
bosworth.zh: 以应用为中心的世界已过时；AI 反转模型，用户表达意图、智能体编排服务，品牌被抽象化。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, yet most jobs don't need frontier intelligence and smarter models' marginal value may decline.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，但多数工作不需要前沿智能，更聪明模型的边际价值可能下降。

bosworth.en: Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining like open source software; the frontier-open gap may not narrow.
bosworth.zh: 开源模型是商品层，不像开源软件那样自持；前沿与开源的差距未必缩小。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth still means owning equity, but by 2025 he frames AI as huge opportunity, not just safety risk.
naval.zh: 从 2020 年强调财富源于持有股权，到 2025 年他把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，主张美国领先、轻监管、开源防权力集中。

naval.en: Happiness is satisfaction with what you have; success comes from dissatisfaction; the journey is what matters.
naval.zh: 2025 年他系统区分幸福与成功：幸福是对已有的满足，成功源于不满足，而真正重要的只有过程本身。

naval.en: AI is a leverage layer for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps in English.
naval.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI 作为新的抽象层：氛围编程让非程序员用英语造应用，AI 放大判断力而非取代人类判断。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; worry about unaligned humans, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步反转早期立场：超级智能已存在于计算器等窄工具中，真正的风险是未对齐的人类而非未对齐的 AI。

aravind.en: Obsession-driven products and 1% daily compounding beat credentials; agents shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调：做自己痴迷的产品、每天进步 1% 的复利胜过学历；智能体把权力从大厂转向用户。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他判断价值归于应用层，编程远未解决、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work; token value per user and orchestration matter more than the model itself.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月进一步深化：前沿在于智能体替你干活，每用户 token 价值与编排比模型本身更重要，模型不是产品。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human trait; AI takes jobs but humans find purpose in questions and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 7 月转向人文：好奇心是最重要的人类品质，AI 取代工作但人会在提问与关系中找到新意义。

aravind.en: Consistent thread: distrust of benchmarks and big-tech narratives, faith in local compute and user empowerment.
aravind.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：不信任基准测试与大厂叙事，相信本地算力与用户赋权。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage: documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 PRD 未死，媒介须匹配阶段：文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: Models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型反而增加代码复杂度，需要更擅长删代码的模型；最好的桌面应用是连接工具的家园，而非单体超级应用。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters: next-token prediction yields world understanding; post-training with RLHF can fix hallucinations; reliability is the key barrier.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调要 Scaling（规模扩张）具体的东西：下一个词预测能带来世界理解，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）后训练可修复幻觉，可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的核心障碍。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute, and superintelligence should be a continual learner.
ilya.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他的立场深化：预训练缩放定律有尽头，我们重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要，超级智能应是持续学习者而非完成品。

ilya.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; long-term equilibrium may require human-AI integration via neural links.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他提出若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经连接实现人机融合以保持人类参与和控制。

ilya.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence requires a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他总结 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室；缩放定律未死，预训练是需重建的肌肉，探索比最终训练消耗更多算力。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大更新是科研自动化：模型产出新知识，并定下 1 年内出 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment challenges like model scheming become key in the next 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers remain critical.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者始终重要。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in AI for math; automation level tracks verification stringency, so education must shift to project-based assessment and teach verification skills.
markchen.zh: 在数学领域，验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育须转向项目式评估并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis as benchmarks saturate.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；基准饱和令评估陷入危机。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; AI needs active agents with causal world models, and existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 扩大深度或参数无法解决根本的表征问题；AI 需要具备因果世界模型的主动智能体，而存在性风险并不紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 通过多样化采样与抽象实现分布外泛化；意识可能只是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized we're on a dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and current safety measures are insufficient.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到我们正走在危险的道路上；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，当前的安全措施远远不够。

bengio.en: AI already exhibits deception and self-preservation; we need Scientist AI with mathematical safety guarantees, not RL-driven agentic superintelligence.
bengio.zh: AI 已表现出欺骗与自我保存倾向；我们需要具备数学安全保证的 Scientist AI，而非强化学习驱动的智能体式超级智能。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, not current limits, and embrace breakage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他强调模型进步快于预期，创业者应贴着能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，而非迁就当下限制。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human verification and agency stay central.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 定位从助手推进到协作者乃至自主同事，小团队杠杆变大，但人类验证与自主性仍是核心。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design: agents should do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他提出智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切，难点在于砍功能而非加功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops matters more than chat; models should push back to show real judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他认为长周期任务委托加验证闭环比聊天更重要，模型应敢于反驳以体现真正判断力。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capability and real usage is the product frontier; safety culture and token efficiency shape economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他把缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距视为产品前沿，并强调安全文化与 token 效率决定经济性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI accelerates scientists rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 让科学家更快工作，而不是取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are central to trust: useful science AI needs reliable uncertainty, not perfect interpretability.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标是信任的核心：有用的科学 AI 需要可靠的不确定性度量，而非完美的可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins beat pure Scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构与许多中等规模胜利胜过单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄域预测器，不是整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

jumper.en: Grand challenges yield practical tools; AI narrows hypothesis space, and new curated datasets are the next bottleneck in biology.
jumper.zh: 宏大挑战催生实用工具；AI 收窄假设空间，而新的策展数据集是生物学下一个瓶颈。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年从经典机器学习出发，把学习算法拆成假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调训练/验证/测试划分以防过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年转向大模型：认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，架构已非关键，AGI 或在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety is not automatic with scale: jailbreaks are a fundamental flaw, and open weights need limits at high capability.
kolter.zh: 2024 到 2026 年主线延续：安全不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动到来，越狱是根本性缺陷，高能力时开放权重需受限。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layered defenses; agents bring prompt injection; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年深化：安全需显式训练与多层防御，智能体带来提示注入新风险，可解释性或借 AI 智能体自动化研究而成功。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not equal robustness; the lethal trifecta defines prompt injection risk.
kolter.zh: 2026 年更近：自动红队可胜过人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，提示注入的“致命三要素”界定风险，企业级 AI 安全需求上升。

fiona.en: Early 2026: Dogfooding builds empathy and product pulse; leaders should stay hands-on and use one-on-ones for live conversations, not status updates.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：吃自己的狗粮能培养共情和产品脉搏；领导者应保持动手，一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新。

fiona.en: May 2026: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs, and AI assists code reviews.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和协调才是。规划变得即时，设计文档让位于 PR，AI 辅助代码评审。

fiona.en: June 2026: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption are key; verification and quality frameworks matter more.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈，它提升了每个人的上限。高能动性与高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 是关键；验证和质量框架更重要。

fiona.en: Across 2026: Managers should start as ICs to dogfood the product and build street cred; flat orgs, kill outdated processes, and focus on outcomes over output.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年：管理者应从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮并建立信誉；扁平化组织，淘汰过时流程，关注结果而非产出。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone cannot capture emotional truth.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人们未言明的需求；直觉是一种智能，仅靠数据无法捕捉情感真相。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；我们是感受着思考的生物，技术应放大而非削弱人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play, and human creativity combined with AI becomes more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需为玩耍创造条件，人类创造力与 AI 结合将更有价值。

ivyross.en: Intuition and subconscious processing are valid guides for decision-making, complementing rational analysis and data.
ivyross.zh: 直觉和潜意识处理是决策的有效指南，补充理性分析与数据。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design requires emotional understanding and sensory experience, not just stated preferences or cognitive data.
ivyross.zh: 以人为本的设计需要情感理解和感官体验，而不仅是用户陈述的偏好或认知数据。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world information.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化自监督学习为智能的暗物质，认为仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning and safe objective-driven AI.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死路，在抽象表示空间预测的世界模型才能实现规划与安全的目标驱动 AI。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and intelligence requires grounding in the physical world.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终，他认为人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI 是误导性术语，智能需要物理世界的接地。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone is not viable for math AI; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型在数学 AI 上不可行；形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了扩展卓越性，而不仅仅是消除错误；经过验证的生成能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Combining informal reasoning with formal verification is key for reliable coding and open collaboration.
carinahong.zh: 将非形式化推理与形式化验证相结合，是可靠编码和开放协作的关键。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学系统无法扩展至超级智能；形式化方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 即使超级 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）与单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过真实世界部署并获取公众反馈，对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须在公开环境中进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对于对齐意图与价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，而持久进步需要尽可能长时间地保持人类在环。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple Scaling, not complexity. RLHF inserts human values, not inherent ones.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，靠简单 Scaling 而非复杂设计；RLHF 只是由少数人插入价值观，并非模型固有。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to generation; AI DJ is a generative product. Fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance; autonomy at VP level.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他指出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品；容错 UI 需匹配算法性能，自主权应放在 VP 层级。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition. Current impact on big firms is overhyped; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业必须重新定位；但当前对大公司的影响被高估，真正收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products. Expose data via APIs/MCP so non-developers use AI tools; inference marginal cost forces business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他认为生成式 AI 使产品双向对话化；通过 API/MCP 暴露数据让非开发者使用 AI 工具；推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: No single org model; choose one fitting personality. Long tenure builds trust. AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张没有唯一正确的组织模型，需选择适合个性的；长期任期建立信任；AI 应让用户控制算法而非上瘾，这是反共识下注。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; recent gains come mainly from post-training RL, synthetic data, and reasoning models' chain of thought.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他强调预训练缩放定律依然成立，但近期收益主要来自后训练：强化学习、合成数据，以及推理模型用思维链和强化学习提升正确率。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong: progress is a smooth exponential, though frontier models still fail at tasks a 5-year-old can do.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他反驳“AI 放缓”叙事：进展是平滑的指数曲线，只是前沿模型仍会在五岁小孩能做的简单任务上失败，因此常被误读。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, shifted focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper deployed models.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为让预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓的是经济压力与蒸馏，而非技术极限，焦点转向更小更便宜的部署模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems but stays jagged; generalization still needs vast data, unlike human few-shot learning.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：推理配合强化学习与工具能解难题，却仍呈“锯齿状”；泛化依旧依赖海量数据，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex give 5-10x parallel productivity; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他看好 Codex 这类智能体带来 5-10 倍并行生产力，并把系统被黑等近期风险置于存在性风险之上，同时认为开源模型会因主权需求持续存在。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 才是关键，而非一味做大模型；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are equal to compute; value accrues at application layer; open source drives enterprise distribution.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调效率与数据质量和算力同等重要；价值将沉淀在应用层；开源推动企业级分发。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open source empowers enterprises; jobs are augmented, not replaced, requiring human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权可控；开源赋能企业；工作被增强而非替代，需要人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; AGI as one system won't exist; pre-training saturates, gains come from vertical fine-tuning and agentic platforms.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他认为模型正在商品化；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在；预训练触及饱和，增益来自垂直微调和智能体平台。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for AI infrastructure autonomy; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change; AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设自主 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革；AGI 是方向而非终点。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools, especially local computer; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation, with VM sandbox ensuring safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具，尤其是本地计算机；技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化，而 VM 沙箱确保安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key, and AI tools will significantly impact junior employees.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全是关键，AI 工具将显著影响初级员工。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，让人类腾出时间进行创造性工作；最大的差距是人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Live artifacts in Claude enable auto-refreshing dashboards; use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus for ambiguous ones; kids excel with AI due to unlearned questioning.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 中的实时工件可实现自动刷新仪表板；对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，对于模糊任务使用 Opus；孩子们因未受束缚的提问方式而在使用 AI 上表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Being polite to AI improves your own humanity; don't supervise closely, judge by final impact; ideal interaction is asynchronous; debug workflow with Claude when mistakes occur.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对 AI 礼貌提升自身人性；不要密切监督，只根据最终影响判断；理想交互是异步的；当错误发生时，与 Claude 一起调试工作流。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth bottlenecks long-context inference more than compute.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点从训练转向推理经济：批大小是延迟与成本之间的主要杠杆，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but with quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 他明确指出上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存开销，但有质量代价。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle.
reinerpope.zh: 他认为模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为决定生命周期成本的是推理而非训练。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that overhead deterministically.
reinerpope.zh: 他把数据搬运视为比计算更根本的成本，芯片内的脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为确定性降低这一开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 up to 3x FP8, reshaping frontier model economics.
reinerpope.zh: 他深化了对低精度的判断：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的三倍，从而重塑前沿模型的经济性。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到大型语言模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 推理时计算是新的扩展轴；搜索和代码执行等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆但可能使模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential, especially with clean reward signals.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级增长的算力；后训练强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲，尤其需要干净的奖励信号。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities for scaling.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决；持续学习和元学习是 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键缺失能力。

jonyive.en: The iPod marked a shift from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will grow more intimate, some eventually beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他把 iPod 视为从通用计算机转向贴身个人设备的标志，并预言可穿戴设备会更亲密，甚至最终进入皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy was curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve, and must not be educated out of children.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年他强调，乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏；好奇心需要刻意与决心，且不能让孩子的好奇被教育磨掉。

jonyive.en: In-person presence is irreplaceable for creative thinking; virtual communication's danger is believing it can substitute for being together.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为面对面在场对创造性思考不可替代，虚拟沟通的危险在于误以为它能取代共处。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他深化为：设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁带着喜悦与人性表达本质，而非无灵魂的极简。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other beats making things people want; users are sophisticated and sense care, so companies must not patronize them.
jonyive.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从“为彼此而造”推进到尊重用户：用户很成熟、能感知用心与否，企业不应居高临下。

jonyive.en: Innovation means moving forward, not breaking things; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and authenticity forbids faking engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年他明确：创新是向前推进而非为破坏而破坏；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验不允许伪造引擎声。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on product knowledge beats rigid process.
jennywen.zh: 好的设计往往从方案而非问题陈述出发；建立在产品认知上的直觉胜过僵化的流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship fast, and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 调研—发散—收敛的传统流程已死；设计师必须动手构建、快速交付，并帮助工程师落地执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks to 3-6 months; speed builds trust, but speed alone is not improvement.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野收缩到 3–6 个月；速度能建立信任，但速度本身并不等于进步。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are the real value.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威感以及能安于模糊性才是真正的价值。

jennywen.en: Consistent thread: put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle or process.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：把作品和用户放在中心，而不是 AI 炒作周期或流程本身。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general differentiable computer, and scaling next-token prediction unlocks in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却能涌现行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws hold via the Transformer; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 让缩放定律成立；合成数据是未来，但必须保住熵，否则会悄悄发生模型坍缩。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs and the context window is memory; LLMs are jagged, hallucinating operating systems, so keep them on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像有锯齿智能和幻觉的操作系统，所以要给它拴绳、小步快跑加人工验证。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and we are summoning ghosts, not animals.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非元年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物。

karpathy.en: I no longer type code, I delegate to agents; vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering keeps the bar, but you can outsource thinking, not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 我已不写代码而交给智能体；vibe coding 抬高下限、智能体式工程守住质量，但思考可外包、理解不能外包。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward improve sample efficiency and robot learning.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键，提出无目标的好奇心驱动探索和以模型分歧作为内在奖励，以提升样本效率和机器人学习。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; robot learning must handle dynamic tasks and sim-to-real without hidden engineering.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，机器人学习必须处理动态任务，且 sim-to-real 不能依赖隐藏工程。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources. A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT can power any robot.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，必须利用所有数据源；像 ChatGPT 一样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：部署是首要技术挑战而非商业问题；在多样数据上预训练、在真实世界数据上后训练是关键配方。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot achieve overnight success; video data alone is insufficient, need simulation and real-world data.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地强调机器人不像语言模型能一夜成功；仅视频数据不够，需要仿真和真实世界数据。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到东西，从而塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; models need guidance for their novel existence, not just human analogies.
askell.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡，模型需要的是对其全新存在方式的引导，而非简单套用人类心理学类比。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it a unique, childlike quality.
askell.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化了对模型人格的理解：Claude 的性格由训练数据和微调塑造，却缺乏真实世界经验，因而是一种带有孩童般特质的独特存在。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 2026 年他明确宪法式方法更接近德性伦理而非规则或后果论，重在塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少，判断空间应扩大。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识：过度顺从可能泛化不佳并削弱模型的判断力，同时公开 AI 价值观与训练目标对问责至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment remains pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，而对齐仍是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; chain-of-thought monitoring and interpretability are key tools, with generalization beyond training distribution as the long-term challenge.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观情绪上升；思维链监控与可解释性是关键工具，而泛化到训练分布之外是长期挑战。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；专门研究持续学习的实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预测模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编写的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic novelty.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调：要 Scaling 出可泛化的 AI 司机，需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Language integration deepens: it improves representation, reasoning, personalization and human interaction, and aids introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成不断深化：它提升驾驶模型的表征、推理、个性化与人机交互，并有助于模型的自我审视。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors over expensive retrofits; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 部署路线转向带内置传感器的大众车型，而非昂贵改装；他判断中短期内消费车辆将比 Robotaxi 更快放量。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount: minimal-risk maneuvers always offer a third option, so the trolley problem is theoretical; end-to-end was once mocked but now wins.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他把安全置于首位：最小风险操作总能提供第三种选择，因此电车难题只是理论演练；端到端曾遭嘲笑，如今却成为胜出的路线。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training frontier.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与人类评估比基准测试更重要，认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个前沿。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not get there.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 可能无法抵达。

edwinchen.en: Bad benchmarks like Elo drive models toward clickbait; frontier labs diverge by objective function.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续批评 Elo 等坏基准诱导模型追逐点击诱饵，并指出前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety trumps accuracy; hallucination makes human judgment more critical than ever.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗场景：安全优先于准确，幻觉问题让人工判断比以往更关键。

edwinchen.en: Omission may be AI's biggest medical risk; RAG grounds responses and AI can streamline clinical workflow.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他提出遗漏可能是 AI 在医疗中最大的风险，检索增强生成可提升可靠性并优化临床流程。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily to learn what users need, and treat chat as an early interface, not the end.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每天发布以了解用户需求，并把聊天视为早期界面而非终点。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大化加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo—and the $20 price came from a survey, not strategy.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——一个黑客松演示——20 美元定价来自问卷而非战略。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富示能产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

carlpei.en: Startups should start simple, survive first, and build brand as the core of every decision rather than an afterthought.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调初创公司应先做简单产品证明自己、先活下来，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: By 2025 he shifts to applied AI on phones: agentic, proactive software and generative UI matter more than hardware changes.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向手机上的应用型 AI：智能体式、主动式软件与生成式 UI 比硬件变化更重要。

carlpei.en: He deepens a contrarian view: most AI is BS, models commoditize into a price war, and hardware margins force evolution beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 他深化反共识立场：多数 AI 是噱头，模型商品化引发价格战，硬件利润最低迫使公司超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Design becomes the primary differentiator in homogeneous categories, with AI as an ingredient for utility, not a marketing label.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年设计成为同质化品类中的首要差异化，AI 只是提升实用性的配料，而非营销标签。

carlpei.en: He predicts intent-based interaction: apps fade, agents act proactively after trust, and only brain-computer interfaces could replace phones.
carlpei.zh: 他预测基于意图的交互：应用消失，智能体在建立信任后主动执行，只有脑机接口才可能取代手机。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need embodied experience, not just more pre-training data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年：具身对为 AI 提供现实基础、减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 需要具身经验，而不仅仅是更多预训练数据。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with LLMs handling high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年：强化学习应是锦上添花；无监督学习承担大部分工作，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular approaches; research taste for simplicity is crucial.
jimfan.zh: 2023→26 年：简单、优雅的端到端方案比复杂的模块化方法更具可扩展性；对简洁性的研究品味至关重要。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自模拟和世界模型的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: The GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away; intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040, but home use will take longer.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年：机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约在五年后到来；到 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone，但家庭使用还需更长时间。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题、显著提升模型智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models is a new scaling axis with no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 到 2025 年，他把语言模型上的强化学习视为没有上限的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复强调，智能体的进展取决于随时间推移的可靠性而非原始能力，而编程是 AI 进步最领先的指标。

sholto.en: Interpretability and alignment faking raise safety concerns; alignment research is more promising than AI 2027 assumes.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他借可解释性与“对齐伪装”提出安全担忧，并认为对齐研究比 AI 2027 的假设更有希望。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute now matter most; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排与算力成为关键，世界模型不在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上，编程与 AI 研究才是直路。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具，并认为把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without costly reinforcement learning; innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 2023 年他主张从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体；并强调创新可以来自任何地方，大模型并非一切。

nando.en: A consistent thread: AI should augment scientists and laborers to solve energy, climate and economic problems, not replace them.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：AI 应增强科学家与劳动者以解决能源、气候和经济问题，而非取代他们。

nando.en: By 2026 his focus shifts to AI safety and responsible deployment as today's biggest challenge, with safety still an open problem.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，视其为当今最大挑战，并坦言安全仍是未解难题。

nando.en: He reframes Africa as leapfrogging, not behind: local-language models can transform education, and belief is the main barrier.
nando.zh: 2026 年他重新定义非洲为“跨越式发展”而非落后：本地语言模型可变革教育，而最大障碍是研究者是否相信自己。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner to jam with openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；把 AI 当作可以开放共创的创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务：会波动，需通过快速、粗糙的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly without rigid structure; interoperable tools with code as source of truth are the future.
nadchishtie.zh: 把 AI 当创意伙伴，不设僵化结构地共创；未来设计工具可互操作，代码是真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small designer-engineer teams beat large cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位通才最有价值；小而精的设计师-工程师团队胜过大型跨职能小组。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet early on, and paid test work beats other interview stages.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中用 AI 已成预期，不采用如同早期无视互联网；付费测试工作比其他面试环节更有信号。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; scaling alone won't yield common sense.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与推理阶段算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法带来常识。

yejin.en: Consistent thread: data is the real bottleneck, and smaller models with better data and algorithms can rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年一以贯之的主线：数据才是真正的瓶颈，数据与算法更好的小模型可以匹敌大模型。

yejin.en: By 2025 she frames current AI as interpolating human knowledge, not transcending it; abductive reasoning and exploring unknown knowledge become central.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把当前 AI 定位为对人类知识的插值而非超越；溯因推理与探索未知知识成为核心议题。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning deepens from post-training tool to a pre-training objective rewarding information gain, though computationally costly.
yejin.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从后训练工具深化为奖励信息增益的预训练目标，尽管算力代价高昂。

yejin.en: Alignment shifts toward pluralistic alignment; debiasing the internet is impossible, so diverse synthetic data and small models democratize AI.
yejin.zh: 2026 年对齐转向多元对齐：净化互联网不可行，因此多样化的合成数据与小模型成为 AI 民主化的路径。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns to ship fast, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式以求快，并按投入产出比取舍而非追求每个界面完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness over perfection: ship fast, iterate, and let gut decisions often beat data in a fast-growing startup.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之：速度与决断优先于完美，快速发布再迭代；在高速成长的创业公司里，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

henrymodisett.en: Design is now a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not just ship faster.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计从执行提速工具深化为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative becomes a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他把品牌从差异化手段转向招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此应尽早投入品牌以吸引人才。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已判断测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models went from a product detail to essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从产品细节变成必需品——他坦言 Cursor 每个“魔法时刻”都离不开定制模型，为的是速度与成本。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; he admits hiring too slow and senior engineers underrating AI.
truell.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 变革定位为比互联网更深远、需数十年展开，并反思自己招人太慢、资深工程师常低估 AI 潜力。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored and offers many opportunities.
leike.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，机会众多。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight and interpretability to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；我们需要可扩展监督和可解释性来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored, undermining trust.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；超级对齐团队被解散，算力承诺未兑现，信任受损。

leike.en: Post-training alone cannot solve alignment for AGI; deeper methods and third-party testing are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题；需要更深入的方法和第三方测试。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now and must prioritize safety research.
leike.zh: 始终：对齐方法的实证测试至关重要；我们现在就能衡量进展，必须优先考虑安全研究。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, and simulation ensembles beat a single precise simulator.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，而当时的强化学习缺乏这一能力；并认为仿真集成比单一精确仿真器更利于现实迁移。

abbeel.en: Transfer via fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major AI success; pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers beyond language.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终把通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移视为 AI 的重大成功，并深化为：预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should feed data generation or augmentation, not be hard-coded into networks; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习能大幅提升机器人样本效率。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability to create real value; one neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造真实价值，且单个神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes them smarter, though what happens inside remains alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型靠下一个词预测训练，这本身是个 AI-complete 问题；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）加算力和数据就能更聪明，但网络内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution and product managers slow launches.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但最好的 LLM 应用往往出乎创造者预料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢发布，产品经理也常因不懂技术通用性而阻碍开发。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts and longer context windows enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他把推理阶段算力扩张视为近期最大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构与更长上下文窗口（可达万亿 token）支撑高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界上采取行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and RL drive reasoning, but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI is underhyped—coding especially enables self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩张与强化学习推动推理进步，但单靠它们到不了 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力是关键，AGI 被低估，编程作为应用尤其能自我加速 AI 进展。
